<b>Plasmidases</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are the [[Lifeblood#Mutation|plasmified]] form of [[Grom]]s that have become fused to the ceiling and are no longer able to move freely.<ref>Plasmidas [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Large worm mutated heavily by Plasmium. The creature has become fused to the roof of its cave, no longer able to move freely."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Plasmidases remain stationary on the ceilings of cave passages. When [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches or attacks them from a distance, they spray droplets of [[Lifeblood|Plasmium]] in a continuous burst around their bodies for 1.75 seconds. After a short period of not taking damage, Plasmidases rapidly heal themselves at a rate of 10 health every 0.75 seconds.

Plasmidases deal {{Damage|2}} with their attack and on contact.

Due to their regenerative ability and tendency to shoot blobs in all directions, damaging Plasmidases from a distance with [[Tools]] or {{CrestSlot|Skill|s}} may be more effective than [[Needle]] attacks. Plasmidases cannot be damaged by the cloud of venom spawned after using the [[Plasmium Phial]] or the [[Flea Brew]] while the [[Pollip Pouch]] is equipped. Extracting [[Plasmified Blood]] from Plasmidases using the [[Needle Phial]], obtained by initiating the <i>[[Alchemist's Assistant]]</i> or <i>[[Advanced Alchemy]]</i> [[wish]]es, kills them immediately.

== Location ==
Plasmidases can be found in the [[Wormways]] during [[Act 3]].

== Trivia ==
* Though Plasmidases do not react to the [[Needolin]], they "sing" on their own.
* Piercing Plasmidases with the [[Needle Phial]] instantly counts as a kill for the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]], even if the extraction is interrupted by taking damage. This makes it possible to complete the entry without actually killing any Plasmidases.
